`UserIcon` is used in two places in the patient chart, both as the icon inside an "orderer information" tooltip. Each one is a local `InfoTooltip` helper, and `MedicationRecord` renders one of them. The definition lives in `openmrs-esm-core`, and it is re-exported through `@openmrs/esm-framework`.

**Chart code that uses `UserIcon`:**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.component.tsx`: `InfoTooltip` (lines 376–382) renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside an `IconButton`. It is called at line 204 with the medication's orderer name as the label.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.component.tsx`: `InfoTooltip` (lines 105–117) renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside a `ToggletipButton`. `MedicationRecord` (lines 13–103) calls it at line 27, so `MedicationRecord` is also affected. `order-details-table.component.tsx` renders `MedicationRecord` at line 561.

**Framework code that defines it:**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx` (lines 824–828) defines `UserIcon` as a memoised `forwardRef` wrapper around the `omrs-icon-user` icon.
- The `esm-styleguide` mocks (`mock.tsx` line 99, `mock-jest.tsx` line 98) stub it as a plain `<span>`. Tests that depend on those mocks would not reflect a behaviour change in the real icon.

I did not read the full enclosing component at `medications-details-table.component.tsx` (around line 204) or `order-details-table.component.tsx` (around line 561), so those call sites are cited by line only.
